name: Eagle Owl
how: Sold by the pet vendor Shylenai. Route comes from beta or datamined sources and has not been confirmed in live play.

name: Excitable Slime
how: Buy a Nutritious Slime Sludge from Boyle. Then /dance at an Excitable Slime in the Undercity canal until it offers the quest WRIGGLE, and hand over the sludge. The reward is the pet. Steps come from the beta.
where: Boyle, Undercity (56.2, 64.6); slime in the Undercity canals
cost: Price of the sludge not confirmed

name: Jungle Boa
how: Sold by the snake vendor Xan'tish. Route comes from beta or datamined sources and has not been confirmed in live play.

name: Packmule Treat
how: Teaches the Minimule companion. Bought with Merchant's Favor at Revered (tooltip). Guides disagree on the vendor: Tamelyn Aldridge and Gishah, or Huey Sunnydale and Okamache. Check in game.

name: Plagued Cockroach
how: Sold by Jeremiah Payson, alongside the classic Cockroach. Route comes from beta or datamined sources and has not been confirmed in live play.

name: Rabbit Crate (Arctic)
how: Teaches Arctic Hare. Sold by Yarlyn Amberstill next to the Snowshoe Rabbit. Route comes from beta or datamined sources and has not been confirmed in live play.

name: Rabbit Crate (Brown)
how: Teaches Brown Rabbit. Sold by Yarlyn Amberstill. Route comes from beta or datamined sources and has not been confirmed in live play.

name: Red Ground Squirrel Whistle
how: Sold by Halpa, alongside the Prairie Dog Whistle. Route comes from beta or datamined sources and has not been confirmed in live play.

name: Brown Ground Squirrel Whistle
how: Sold by Halpa. Route comes from beta or datamined sources and has not been confirmed in live play.

name: Shadowgale Squirrel
how: Requires Revered with the Nightclaw Druids. Reputation comes from turning in Al'Aketh Cultist's Ears (5 ears for 1,000 reputation). Community report; check in game.
cost: Estimated about 52s (unconfirmed); Revered with Nightclaw Druids

name: Undercity Cockroach (Forever)
how: Sold by Jeremiah Payson. Route comes from beta or datamined sources and has not been confirmed in live play.

name: Weevil K. Neevil
how: Reward from the quest My Little Friends (requires level 25). Binds on pickup.

name: Baby Crocolisk
how: Drops from the Sewer Beast, a level 50 elite rare in the Stormwind Canals. Beta groups needed a raid to kill it.

name: Wild Chicken Egg
how: Teaches the Wild Chicken companion. The item is confirmed in the game files, but no source has been found yet.

name: Skybound Breezelet
how: Listed as a zone exotic pet found on Zephras Isle. The exact source was not given.

name: Zephyr Chick
how: Listed as a zone exotic pet found on Zephras Isle. The exact source was not given.

name: Rivergling Turtle
how: Listed as a zone exotic pet found in the Riverglades. The exact source was not given.

name: Amber Strigid Hatchling
how: Listed as a zone exotic pet found in the Riverglades. The exact source was not given.

name: Mossy Pebble-Prowler
how: Listed as a zone exotic pet found in Shen'dralas. The exact source was not given.

name: Bitter Baitling
how: Bought with an Extravagant Extravaganza Coin. Coins go to winners of the Stranglethorn Fishing Extravaganza (Sundays, 2-4 pm); one guide says the first 50 turn-ins. Not confirmed in live play.

name: Flowery Lashling Bud
how: Reported for sale on the Black Market Auction House, where stock and prices rotate. Only a seller site reports this, so treat it as a lead. Other Lashling Bud colours (Frosty, Viridian, Wilted) exist in the files.

name: Musical Gustjumper
how: Find the colourful frogs on a rock in the river south of the Shriekling Den, past a log and a waterfall. Target one and /sing. After the frogs hop around, a Musical Gustjumper appears on the log behind you to pick up.

name: Shaking Egg
how: Teaches Condor Hatchling. Drops from the rare Lord Condar.

name: Tallstrider Hatchling
how: Drops from the rare Strider Clutchmother.

name: Prairie Wolf Pup Carrier
how: Sold by Mayhoa Skyhoof.

name: Chicken Egg
how: Classic data lists it as a very rare drop (0.02%) from Harvest Watchers and Mangy Wolves in Elwynn Forest. WoWFun has a community report pointing to Westfall. The source may have changed in Forever.

name: Galestrider Chick
how: Teaches the Galestrider Chick companion. The item exists in the game files, but no source has been found yet.
